title: A Longitudinal Analysis of Racial and Gender Bias in New York Times and Fox News Images and Articles

bias_targets.methodology: Image classification to measure representation frequency and prominence (image area) of different racial groups in news images, combined with NLP models (RoBERTa, BART, GPT-4) to analyze sentiment, emotional tilt, topic associations, and victim/perpetrator framing in news article text.
Image classification using a CNN model to measure the frequency of appearance and normalized bounding box area (prominence) of male versus female subjects in news images.
Image classification using a fine-tuned Vision Transformer to group subjects into age brackets, measuring the age distribution and representation frequency of subjects in news images.
